name: AgroData Connect
hero_sub_en: linktr.ee/agrodataconnect · Colombia · Food & Agriculture · Stage: Ideation · CT-IC-005
hero_sub_es: linktr.ee/agrodataconnect · Colombia · Food & Agriculture · Etapa: Ideation · CT-IC-005
pitch_en: AgroData Connect is an AI-powered platform that helps smallholder farmers monitor crops, detect risks, and make data-driven decisions. It improves productivity, reduces losses, and enables climate-resilient agriculture in low-connectivity environments.
pitch_es: AgroData Connect is an AI-powered platform that helps smallholder farmers monitor crops, detect risks, and make data-driven decisions. It improves productivity, reduces losses, and enables climate-resilient agriculture in low-connectivity environments.
cta_pitch_en: AgroData Connect uses AI to help farmers monitor crops, detect risks, and make climate-smart decisions via WhatsApp, mobile, and web—even offline—improving resilience and reducing losses.
cta_pitch_es: AgroData Connect uses AI to help farmers monitor crops, detect risks, and make climate-smart decisions via WhatsApp, mobile, and web—even offline—improving resilience and reducing losses.
